activity.notes: Raden Patah is traditionally identified as the founder and first ruler of the Demak Sultanate. Indonesia's official tourism portal gives the conventional span 1475-1518 while explicitly framing the foundation attribution and genealogy as traditional. ATLAS therefore preserves that conventional reign span with approximate boundaries rather than presenting it as a fully contemporary exact chronology.

sources.title: Demak — Indonesia Travel
sources.citation_text: Indonesia's official tourism portal attributes the foundation of the Demak Sultanate to Raden Patah and gives the conventional dates 1475-1518, while noting the traditional character of his genealogy.
